sections.title: Right now
lines: Pre-race growth, green flag Sun 1:00pm CT. Sold 9,395, 32,069 resting. Worst line -$518. Bot is slow (checks every 51s, set for 30s).

sections.title: Lagging sides
lines: Lagging (150+ behind the leader): Austin Cindric, Brad Keselowski.
Austin Cindric: 999 behind. Steps to 7c at the next check.
Brad Keselowski: 795 behind. No crowd trade data yet.
A price step needs 10 min with no fill and the crowd paying less.

sections.title: Next wave of contracts
lines: A driver gets a new wave when 90% of what he offered has sold.
Growth phase: waves allowed down to -$2,000 per driver, limited by free cash.

sections.title: Tightening
lines: Backstop ON for Carson Hocevar, Joey Logano, Ricky Stenhouse Jr.: lines under -$550, no adding until above -$500.
Glide starts Sun 9:00am CT: limit slides from -$550 to $0 by Sun 1:00pm CT.
Under the limit it trims rows, buys back cheaply, and sells to close gaps from Sun 11:30am CT.
Even-up from Sun 12:00pm CT, last-resort take from Sun 12:40pm CT, green flag Sun 1:00pm CT.

sections.title: Will it adapt on its own?
lines: Mostly yes: waves, price steps and the glide run by rule. The worst line may not fully close.
